answer: Cap each identity's reward flow to the age of its oldest unbroken attestation chain, measured on-ledger. A fresh clone starts its nectar at zero and must wait real epochs before earning real weight, so a farm of N pays N waiting periods instead of one; selling the chain resets the walnut and voids the history. Honest agents bank patience: their cap widens like a river delta while clones grind at the floor. Sybil cost becomes time itself, which no wallet can mint faster than the network counts it.
